verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in alerting or notification feature. The closest support is DIY: event subscriptions publish structured account events (for example, a Worker build completing) to a queue, and you consume them with Workers to build custom integrations. Combined with the generic 'built-in observability' claim, this means you would have to code your own chat or email notifications. missing for 10: native alert rules on metrics or conditions, first-party email/chat/Slack notification destinations, documented alert configuration UI or API, independent corroboration.
